action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Update RouxController, SproutController, and GlazeController to set UserId when creating/updating AppSetting entities. The AppSetting entity has a composite primary key (Key, UserId) - controllers must provide a valid UserId (e.g., 'system' or the current user's ID) when adding new settings.
FIX: In SproutController.GenerateApiKey(), ensure the base64 string is long enough before calling substring [..32]
critical_code_review_comments: AppSetting entity has composite key (Key, UserId) but new module controllers (Roux, Sprout, Glaze) don't set UserId when creating settings - causes 500 errors on POST/PUT operations
All GET endpoints work correctly - only write operations fail
Frontend pages are well-designed with proper data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: WatchNexus v2.8.3 has 7 new module pages (Glaze, Saffron, Fondue, Sourdough, Churro, Roux, Sprout) all loading correctly. Backend GET endpoints work but POST/PUT operations on Roux, Sprout, Glaze fail with 500 due to AppSetting UserId issue. P0 fixes verified: Gadgets (30 plugins), Theme Forge, Library page all working. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_watchnexus_v283_modules.py

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: AppSetting entity in /app/src/watchnexus/shared/Module.cs has composite primary key (Key, UserId) configured in AppDbContext. When controllers like RouxController, SproutController, GlazeController create new AppSetting records, they don't set the UserId property, causing EF Core to throw 'Unable to track an entity of type AppSetting because its primary key property UserId is null'
rca_of_the_issue.fix_suggestion: When creating new AppSetting, set UserId to a system value like 'system' or extract user ID from JWT claims: new AppSetting { Key = 'key', Value = 'value', UserId = 'system' }
